words.ex_cn: 他吃了止痛药来缓解头痛。
words.en: Painkillers are drugs used to reduce or eliminate pain without causing loss of consciousness.

words.ex: He felt great pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到极大的痛苦。
words.en: Pain is the feeling of great discomfort you have, for example when you have been hurt or when you are ill.

words.ex: He hurt his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: If you hurt someone, you cause them to feel pain. If you hurt a part of your body, you feel pain there. If someone is hurt, they are injured.

words.tr:
n. 损害；破损；
v. 损害；破坏；
words.ex: The storm caused serious damage to the house.
words.ex_cn: 风暴对房屋造成了严重损害。
words.en: Damage is physical harm that is caused to something which makes it less attractive, useful, or valuable.

words.ex: He got an injury while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时受了伤。
words.en: An injury is damage to your body. It is a general term that refers to harm caused by accidents, falls, hits, weapons, etc.

words.ex: Many diseases can be prevented with clean water.
words.ex_cn: 许多疾病可以通过干净的水来预防。
words.en: A disease is an illness which affects people, animals, or plants, for example one which is caused by bacteria or infection.

words.tr: n. 风险；“risk”的复数； v. 冒……风险；
words.ex: He knows the risks of climbing that mountain.
words.ex_cn: 他知道爬那座山的风险。
words.en: The possibility of something bad happening.

words.ex: He has many problems with math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上有很多问题。
words.en: A problem is a situation that is unsatisfactory and causes difficulties for people.

words.ex: The teacher gave a clear description of the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 老师对实验做了清晰的描述。
words.en: A description of someone or something is a statement that explains what they are or what they are like.

words.ex: His status in the company is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他在公司里的地位很高。
words.en: The status of someone or something is their position or situation according to the law or according to other people's opinions.

words.tr:
n. 脂肪；
adj. 肥的；
words.ex: This food has too much fat.
words.ex_cn: 这种食物含有太多脂肪。
words.en: Fat is a substance contained in foods such as meat, cheese, and butter, which is used by the body to produce energy or stored in the body as a layer.

words.ex: He lost a lot of blood after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失了很多血。
words.en: The red liquid that flows through the bodies of humans and animals, carrying oxygen and nutrients.

words.ex: The scientist studied the genetic structure of the plant.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究了这种植物的基因结构。
words.en: The arrangement of genes within a particular organism or species, which determines inherited characteristics.

words.ex: The scientist studied genetic traits in plants.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究了植物的基因特征。
words.en: relating to genes or heredity

words.tr: n. 面巾纸；手巾纸；“tissue”的复数；
words.ex: She wiped her nose with a tissue.
words.ex_cn: 她用一张面巾纸擦了鼻子。
words.en: A tissue is a piece of soft thin paper which is used for wiping, especially for wiping the nose. In biology, tissue is a group of cells that have a similar structure and that work together to do a particular job.

words.ex: Hormones control growth and mood in the body.
words.ex_cn: 激素控制身体的生长和情绪。
words.en: Hormones are chemicals produced by the body that regulate the activity of cells or organs. They play a key role in many body processes, including growth, metabolism, and reproduction.

words.ex: Dogs produce saliva when they smell food.
words.ex_cn: 狗闻到食物时会分泌唾液。
words.en: Saliva is the watery liquid that forms in your mouth and helps you to chew and digest food.

words.ex: My feet hurt after walking all day.
words.ex_cn: 我走了一整天，脚很疼。
words.en: The plural of foot, which is the lower extremity of the leg below the ankle, on which a person stands or walks. Also, a unit of linear measure equal to 12 inches (30.48 cm).

words.tr:
n. 手；
v. 交；递；给；
words.ex: He waved his hand to say hello.
words.ex_cn: 他挥挥手打招呼。
words.en: The part of the body at the end of the arm that is used for holding, moving, touching, and feeling things.

words.ex: Smoking damages your lungs.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会损害你的肺。
words.en: The lungs are the organs in the chest that allow you to breathe.

words.ex: Good digestion helps your body absorb nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 良好的消化有助于身体吸收营养。
words.en: The process by which food is broken down in the stomach and intestines so that the body can absorb it and use it for energy and nutrients.

words.ex: The digestive system breaks down food.
words.ex_cn: 消化系统分解食物。
words.en: Relating to the process of digesting food.

words.ex: He ate too much and his stomach hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多了，胃疼。
words.en: The stomach is the organ in your body where food is digested after you have eaten it.

words.ex: He felt a pain in his heart.
words.ex_cn: 他感到心脏疼痛。
words.en: The heart is the organ in your chest that pumps the blood around your body. People also use heart to refer to the area of their chest that is closest to their heart.

words.ex: The dog buried the bones in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 狗把骨头埋在了院子里。
words.en: The hard parts inside a human or animal that make up its skeleton.

words.ex: He brushed his teeth every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上刷牙。
words.en: The hard, white objects in the mouth that are used for biting and chewing.

words.ex: She combs her hair every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上梳头发。
words.en: Hair is the fine threadlike strands growing from the skin of humans and animals, or the mass of such strands growing from the skin of a person's head.

words.ex: The brain controls our thoughts and movements.
words.ex_cn: 大脑控制我们的思想和行动。
words.en: The brain is the organ inside your head that controls your body's activities and enables you to think and to feel things such as heat and pain.

words.tr: n. 面孔；“face”的复数； v. 面临；
words.ex: The children's faces lit up with joy.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们的面孔因喜悦而发光。
words.en: The front part of a person's head from the forehead to the chin, or the corresponding part in an animal; or to confront and deal with a problem or difficult situation.

words.tr:
n. 声音；声响；
v. 听起来；
adj. 健全的；合理的；可靠的；
words.ex: I heard a strange sound at night.
words.ex_cn: 我半夜听到了一个奇怪的声音。
words.en: Sound is a vibration that propagates as an acoustic wave, through a transmission medium such as a gas, liquid or solid. In human physiology and psychology, sound is the reception of such waves and their perception by the brain.

words.ex: I hear voices in the empty house.
words.ex_cn: 我在空房子里听到声音。
words.en: Voices refer to the sounds produced by speaking or singing, or the opinions or wishes of a group of people.

words.ex: His eyesight is getting worse with age.
words.ex_cn: 他的视力随着年龄增长而变差。
words.en: Your eyesight is your ability to see.

words.ex: She has excellent night vision.
words.ex_cn: 她有很好的夜视能力。
words.en: Vision is the ability to see, the area that you can see, the ability to imagine how a country, society, industry, etc. could develop in the future and to plan in a suitable way, or an experience in which you see something that is not really there.

words.tr:
n. 头；脑袋；上端；首脑；
v. 朝…行进；居首位；领导；
adj. 头的；主要的；
words.ex: He hurt his head when he fell.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒时伤到了头。
words.en: The upper part of the human body, or the front or upper part of the body of an animal, typically separated from the rest of the body by a neck, and containing the brain, mouth, and sense organs.

words.ex: The poem uses symbolism to show love and loss.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗使用象征手法来表现爱与失去。
words.en: Symbolism is the use of symbols to represent ideas or qualities.

words.ex: The dove is a symbol of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征。
words.en: Symbols are marks or signs that represent something else, such as an idea, a quality, or a relationship.

words.ex: There is a big statue in the city center.
words.ex_cn: 城市中心有一座巨大的雕像。
words.en: A statue is a large sculpture of a person or an animal, made of stone or metal.

words.ex: The rainwater flows into the collection tank.
words.ex_cn: 雨水流入收集罐。
words.en: A container for collecting and storing liquids, often used in industrial or agricultural settings.

words.ex: His collection of old coins is very rare.
words.ex_cn: 他收集的旧硬币非常稀有。
words.en: A collection is a group of things, often of the same type, that have been gathered together over a period of time.

words.ex: He stored water in large tanks.
words.ex_cn: 他把水储存在大箱子里。
words.en: A tank is a large, heavily armored fighting vehicle with tracks and a large gun that moves on wheels inside the tank. Also, a tank can be a large container for storing liquid or gas.

words.tr: n. 陶器；制陶手艺；陶器作坊；
words.ex: He makes pottery in his backyard studio.
words.ex_cn: 他在后院的工作室制作陶器。
words.en: Objects such as pots, dishes, and vases that are made out of clay and then baked at high temperatures to make them hard.

words.ex: The ancient stones had inscriptions from Roman times.
words.ex_cn: 这些古老的石头上有罗马时代的铭文。
words.en: Words or letters that have been written or carved into something, especially as a historical record or as a form of decoration.

words.ex: The city hosts many art exhibitions every year.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市每年举办许多艺术展览。
words.en: A public display of works of art or other items of interest, held in an art gallery or museum or at a trade fair.

words.ex: We visited the local museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了当地博物馆。
words.en: A small museum that focuses on the history, culture, or artifacts of a specific town, city, or region.

words.ex: We visited a museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一个博物馆。
words.en: A museum is a building where a large number of interesting and valuable objects, such as works of art or historical items, are kept, studied, and displayed to the public.

words.ex: He was sent to prison for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷窃被送进了监狱。
words.en: A prison is a building where criminals are kept as punishment or where people accused of a crime are kept before their trial.

words.ex: The police caught the man for a serious crime.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓住了那个犯下严重罪行的人。
words.en: A crime is an illegal action or activity for which a person can be punished by law.

words.ex: It is illegal to drive without a license.
words.ex_cn: 无证驾驶是非法的。
words.en: If something is illegal, the law says that it is not allowed.

words.ex: He hired a legal lawyer to help him.
words.ex_cn: 他请了一位法律律师来帮助他。
words.en: Relating to the law or to lawyers, or permitted or required by law.

words.ex: The school has strict rules about uniforms.
words.ex_cn: 学校对校服有严格的规定。
words.en: Rules are statements that tell you what is or is not allowed in a particular situation or game, or instructions about how to behave or do something.

words.tr:
n. 标准；
adj. 标准的；规范的；
words.ex: The school has a high standard for homework.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校对作业有很高的标准。
words.en: A standard is a level of quality or achievement, especially a level that is thought to be acceptable.

words.tr:
n. 保卫；警卫；
v. 守卫；
words.ex: The guard stands at the gate to protect the building.
words.ex_cn: 保卫人员站在门口保护大楼。
words.en: A guard is a person who protects a place, person, or thing, or who prevents people from escaping from a place.

words.ex: The soldiers carried weapons to protect the village.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们携带武器保护村庄。
words.en: Weapons are objects designed to be used in fighting or war, such as guns, bombs, knives, etc.

words.ex: The sign has arrows pointing to the exit.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志上有指向出口的箭头。
words.en: Arrows are long, thin weapons that are shot from a bow. They have a sharp point at one end and usually feathers at the other end to help them fly straight.

words.tr:
v. 禁止；
n. 禁止；
words.ex: The school bans phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If there is a ban on something, it is not allowed. If something is banned, it is not allowed to be done, shown, or used.

words.tr:
n. 纪律；学科；科目；训练；惩戒；
v. 约束自己；
words.ex: The teacher enforced discipline in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师在教室里维持纪律。
words.en: Discipline is the practice of making people obey rules or standards of behaviour, and punishing them when they do not.

words.ex: The soldiers marched in a line.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们列队行进。
words.en: A soldier is a person who serves in an army.

words.ex: The army trains new soldiers every month.
words.ex_cn: 军队每个月训练新兵。
words.en: An army is a large organized group of people who are armed and trained to fight on land in a war.

words.ex: The two countries signed a treaty for peace.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了和平条约。
words.en: Peace is a situation or a period of time in which there is no war or violence in a country or an area.

words.ex: The king lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A castle is a large building or group of buildings fortified against attack with thick walls, battlements, towers, and in many cases a moat.

words.ex: The emperor ruled the country for many years.
words.ex_cn: 这位皇帝统治这个国家很多年。
words.en: A male sovereign ruler of an empire.

words.ex: The king lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A king is a man who is the most important member of the royal family of his country, and who is considered to be the head of state of that country.

words.ex: Everyone has the right to speak freely.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有自由发言的权利。
words.en: Rights are legal, social, or ethical principles of freedom or entitlement; that is, rights are the fundamental normative rules about what is allowed of people or owed to people, according to some legal system, social convention, or ethical theory.

words.ex: He votes in a democratic election.
words.ex_cn: 他在民主选举中投票。
words.en: A democratic country, government, or political system is governed by representatives who are elected by the people.

words.tr: n. 钟表；[仪]时钟；[仪]时钟（clock 的复数）；
words.ex: The clocks on the wall show the time.
words.ex_cn: 墙上的钟表显示时间。
words.en: A clock is an instrument for measuring and indicating time, typically by means of pointers moving over a dial.

words.tr: phrase. 观看时间；收视时间
words.ex: My watching time on YouTube is two hours every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天在YouTube上的观看时间是两小时。
words.en: The act of observing or monitoring the passage of time.

words.ex: The zookeeper brings food at feeding time.
words.ex_cn: 饲养员在喂食时间带来食物。
words.en: The time at which animals or people are given food.

words.tr:
n. 时间；时期；次数；
v. 计时；安排时间；
words.ex: I don't have time to finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我没有时间完成作业。
words.en: Time is the ongoing sequence of existence and events that occurs in an apparently irreversible succession from the past, through the present, into the future.

words.ex: My ancestors came from China long ago.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖先很久以前来自中国。
words.en: Your ancestors are the people from whom you are descended.

words.ex: He accepted the gift with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着接受了这份礼物。
words.en: If you accept something that you have been offered, you say yes to it or agree to take it.

words.ex: He signed his name with a clear signature.
words.ex_cn: 他用清晰的签名签了名字。
words.en: A signature is a person's name written in a distinctive way as a form of identification in authorizing a document or letter.

words.ex: He sent some attachments with the email.
words.ex_cn: 他通过电子邮件发送了一些附件。
words.en: Attachments are files that are sent along with an email message.

words.ex: He wrote his email address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的电子邮件地址写在了表格上。
words.en: An email address is a unique identifier for an email account. It is used to send and receive emails over the Internet.

words.ex: He sends an email every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上发一封电子邮件。
words.en: Email is a system for sending messages from one computer to another via the Internet.

words.tr:
n. 结束；尽头；目标；末端；
v. 结束；终止；
words.ex: The end of the movie made everyone cry.
words.ex_cn: 电影的结尾让所有人都哭了。
words.en: The end of something such as a period of time, an event, a book, or a film is the last part of it or the point at which it stops.

words.ex: The new policy is for the promotion of clean energy.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策是为了促进清洁能源。
words.en: A promotion is a move to a more important job or rank in a company or organization.

words.ex: The government provides welfare to poor families.
words.ex_cn: 政府向贫困家庭提供福利。
words.en: The welfare of a person or group is their health, comfort, and happiness.

words.tr: n. 利益；好处；“benefit”的复数； v. 有益于；有助于；
words.ex: The benefits of exercise are clear.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼的好处是显而易见的。
words.en: Benefits are advantages or profits that you get from something, especially advantages that you get from the government or from your employer, such as money or health insurance.

words.ex: He receives his wages every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五领工资。
words.en: Wages are the money that someone is paid each week by their employer, especially for work that is done manually or in a factory.

words.ex: He gets a salary of 3000 dollars each month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月赚3000美元的工资。
words.en: A salary is the money that someone is paid each month by their employer, especially when they are in a profession such as teaching, law, or medicine.

words.ex: His income is enough to pay for rent and food.
words.ex_cn: 他的收入足以支付房租和食物。
words.en: Income is the money that a person or a company earns regularly, for example from investment or work.

words.ex: The company values flexibility in work hours.
words.ex_cn: 公司重视工作时间的灵活性。
words.en: Flexibility refers to the quality of bending easily without breaking, or the ability to be easily modified to respond to altered circumstances or conditions.

words.ex: She is flexible with her schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她的日程安排很灵活。
words.en: Able to change or be changed easily according to the situation.

words.tr:
adj. 最后的；最近的；
v. 持续；
adv. 最后；最近一次；
words.ex: This is the last chance to pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 这是通过考试的最后机会。
words.en: Coming after all others in time or order; final.

words.tr: n. 技能；技巧；技术；“skill”的复数；
words.ex: He developed many skills through practice.
words.ex_cn: 他通过练习掌握了多种技能。
words.en: Skills are the abilities and knowledge that you need in order to do a job or activity.

words.tr:
adj. 专业的；职业的；
n. 专业人士；
words.ex: He is a professional teacher with many years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有多年经验的专业教师。
words.en: A professional is a person who has a job that requires special training and education, especially one that involves a high level of skill or knowledge.

words.ex: He shared his travel experiences with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他跟朋友们分享了他的旅行经历。
words.en: If you experience something, you go through an unusual or exciting event.

words.ex: He got a teaching qualification last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了教师资格。
words.en: A qualification is a skill or type of experience that you need in order to do a particular job or activity.

words.ex: The survey asks about your gender.
words.ex_cn: 这个调查询问你的性别。
words.en: Gender is the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences, not just biological ones.

words.tr:
n. 年龄；时代；
v. 变老；
words.ex: His age is 25 years.
words.ex_cn: 他的年龄是25岁。
words.en: The length of time that a person has lived or a thing has existed.

words.tr: n. 录制的音像；记录；“recording”的复数；
words.ex: He listened to the recordings of his favorite songs.
words.ex_cn: 他听了他最爱歌曲的录音。
words.en: Recordings are sounds or images that have been stored on a tape, disc, or computer so that they can be heard or seen again.

words.tr: n. 记录；“record”的复数； v. 记录；
words.ex: The school keeps records of all student grades.
words.ex_cn: 学校保存所有学生成绩的记录。
words.en: Records refer to information that has been written down or stored on a computer, or to the process of storing information in this way. It can also refer to a musical recording or the act of making a musical recording.

words.ex: He changed his job because of his background.
words.ex_cn: 他因为自己的背景换了工作。
words.en: The background is the situation that exists at a particular time, or the situation in which something happens, which helps to explain it.

words.tr: n. 姓名；名称；“name”的复数； v. 说出…的名字；
words.ex: He wrote down the names of all the students.
words.ex_cn: 他写下了所有学生的姓名。
words.en: A name is a word or set of words by which a person, animal, place, or thing is known, addressed, or referred to.

words.ex: Do not share your personal information online.
words.ex_cn: 不要在网上分享你的个人信息。
words.en: Information about a particular person, such as their name, address, and phone number, that can be used to identify or contact them.

words.ex: His personality is very friendly and outgoing.
words.ex_cn: 他的个性非常友好和外向。
words.en: The combination of characteristics or qualities that form an individual's distinctive character.

words.ex: This is my personal notebook.
words.ex_cn: 这是我的个人笔记本。
words.en: Relating to or belonging to a particular person rather than to a group or an organization.

words.ex: A kind person helped me find my way.
words.ex_cn: 一位善良的人帮我找到了路。
words.en: A human being regarded as an individual.

words.ex: The police used fingerprint identification to find the suspect.
words.ex_cn: 警察使用指纹识别来找到嫌疑人。
words.en: Identification is the act of recognizing and naming someone or something, or the process of proving who or what someone or something is.

words.tr: n. 开头；开端； v. 开始；着手；“begin”的现在分词；
words.ex: The beginning of the story is very exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事的开头非常精彩。
words.en: The point in time or space at which something starts.

words.ex: Employers want workers who are honest and hardworking.
words.ex_cn: 雇主想要诚实且勤奋的员工。
words.en: Employers are individuals or organizations that hire and pay people to work for them.

words.tr: n. 管理者；经理；“manager”的复数；
words.ex: The managers plan the work for their teams.
words.ex_cn: 管理者为他们的团队规划工作。
words.en: Managers are people who are responsible for controlling or administering all or part of a company or similar organization.

words.ex: The leaders of the team made a good decision.
words.ex_cn: 团队的领袖做出了一个正确的决定。
words.en: Leaders are people who guide or direct others, often in a political, business, or organizational context. They are responsible for making decisions, setting goals, and motivating others to achieve those goals.

words.tr:
v. 引导；领导；带头；
n. 主导地位；铅；领先；
words.ex: The teacher leads the students to the library.
words.ex_cn: 老师带领学生去图书馆。
words.en: To be in charge of a group, country, or situation; to guide or direct in a course; a position of advantage in a contest or competition; a heavy, malleable, ductile, bluish-white, dense metallic element.

words.ex: The director of the school gave a speech.
words.ex_cn: 学校的主任发表了一次演讲。
words.en: A director is a person who is in charge of something, especially a film, play, or organization.

words.ex: He went to the post office to send a letter.
words.ex_cn: 他去邮局寄信。
words.en: A post office is a public department or corporation responsible for mail services, including the acceptance, transmission, and delivery of letters and parcels.

words.ex: The head office is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 总部在纽约。
words.en: The main office or center of control of a business or organization, where the most important decisions are made.

words.ex: He works in an office downtown.
words.ex_cn: 他在市中心的一间办公室工作。
words.en: An office is a room or set of rooms where people work, especially in a business or organization.

words.ex: He has three interviews this week.
words.ex_cn: 他这周有三场面试。
words.en: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study, or in order to find out their opinions or experiences.

words.ex: Smartphones have many useful applications.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机有许多有用的程序。
words.en: An application is a formal request to be considered for a position or to be allowed to do or have something, submitted to an authority, institution, or organization. It can also refer to the practical use or relevance of something, or a program or piece of software designed to fulfill a particular purpose.

words.ex: The agency helps people find jobs.
words.ex_cn: 这个机构帮助人们找工作。
words.en: An agency is a business which provides a service on behalf of other businesses.

words.tr: phrase. 关闭；倒闭；停止播音；“close down”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The shop closed down last week.
words.ex_cn: 这家店上周停业了。
words.en: If a business or organization closes down or if someone closes it down, it stops operating.

words.ex: The solution to the problem is simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题的解决办法很简单。
words.en: A solution to a problem is a way of dealing with it so that the difficulty is removed.

words.ex: He uses simple strategies to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他使用简单的策略来解决数学问题。
words.en: A strategy is a plan or method chosen to bring about a desired future, such as achieving a goal or solving a problem.

words.ex: The calculation took only five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 这个计算只花了五分钟。
words.en: The process of using mathematics to find a number or amount.

words.ex: The company made big profits this year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司今年赚了大量利润。
words.en: Profits are the money that a business earns after subtracting all its costs and expenses.

words.tr:
n. 税；税款；
v. 对...征税；
words.ex: He pays tax every year.
words.ex_cn: 他每年缴税。
words.en: A tax is a sum of money that you have to pay to the government so that it can pay for public services.

words.ex: He felt an obligation to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他感到有义务帮助他的朋友。
words.en: An obligation is something that you must do because you have promised, because of a law, etc.

words.tr: adj. 有责任的；负责任的；
words.ex: He is responsible for cleaning the room.
words.ex_cn: 他负责打扫房间。
words.en: If someone or something is responsible for a particular event or situation, they are the cause of it or they can be blamed for it.

words.tr:
n. 信任；信赖；
v. 信任；信赖；
words.ex: I have trust in my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 我信任我最好的朋友。
words.en: If you trust someone, you believe that they are honest and sincere and will not deliberately do anything to harm you.

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.ex: He always follows his morality in daily life.
words.ex_cn: 他日常生活中总是遵循自己的道德。
words.en: Morality is the belief that some behaviour is right and acceptable and that other behaviour is wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 毛皮贸易；皮草交易
words.ex: The fur trade was common in Canada long ago.
words.ex_cn: 很久以前，毛皮贸易在加拿大很普遍。
words.en: The exchange of animal pelts and furs for goods and money, especially between indigenous peoples and European settlers in North America.

words.tr: n. 商人；经销商；“trader”的复数；
words.ex: The traders sell fruit at the market.
words.ex_cn: 商人们在市场卖水果。
words.en: People who buy and sell goods, especially in large quantities.

words.tr:
n. 贸易；交易；行业；
v. 贸易；交易；
words.ex: The two countries increased their trade last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这两个国家增加了贸易。
words.en: Trade involves the buying and selling of goods and services. It can refer to the exchange of goods and services between parties, or to the business of buying and selling goods and services.

words.ex: Children see many advertisements on TV.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在电视上看到很多广告。
words.en: Advertisements are notices, pictures, or films telling people about a product, service, or event.

words.ex: He saw an advertisement on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他在电视上看到一则广告。
words.en: An advertisement is a notice or announcement in a public medium promoting a product, service, or event or publicizing a job vacancy.

words.tr: n. 广告活动；广告业； v. 做广告；“advertise”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company launched a new advertising campaign last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月推出了一项新的广告活动。
words.en: The activity of producing advertisements for commercial products or services.

words.ex: The company will advertise its new phone on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司将在电视上为新手机登广告。
words.en: If you advertise something such as a product, an event, or a job, you tell people about it in newspapers, on television, or on posters in order to encourage them to buy the product, go to the event, or apply for the job.

words.ex: Children see many adverts on TV.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在电视上看到很多广告。
words.en: Adverts are notices or announcements in a public medium promoting a product, service, or event.

words.ex: I buy milk and bread at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 我在超市买牛奶和面包。
words.en: A large self-service store selling foods and household goods.

words.ex: He works in marketing for a tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家科技公司从事营销工作。
words.en: Marketing involves the process of promoting, selling, and distributing a product or service. It includes market research and advertising.

words.ex: The company sells products in the global market.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司在全球市场上销售产品。
words.en: The worldwide arena in which commercial dealings are conducted.

words.ex: We conducted a market survey to understand consumer preferences.
words.ex_cn: 我们进行了市场调查以了解消费者的偏好。
words.en: A market survey is the process of gathering, analyzing, and interpreting information about a market, about a product or service to be offered for sale in that market, and about the past, present, and potential customers for the product or service.

words.tr:
n. 市场；行情；商场；销路；
v. 营销；
words.ex: The market sells fresh vegetables every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场每天早上卖新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: A market is a place where goods are bought and sold, or an area or country where there is a demand for particular goods or services.

words.ex: The city has many industrial factories.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市有许多工业工厂。
words.en: Industrial means relating to or characterized by industry.

words.ex: He works in the tech industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在科技行业工作。
words.en: Industry is the work and processes involved in collecting raw materials, and making them into products in factories.

words.ex: He runs a small business selling bread.
words.ex_cn: 他经营一家卖面包的小生意。
words.en: Business refers to the activity of buying and selling goods and services, or a particular company that does this.

words.tr:
adj. 贸易的；商业的；
n. 广告；
words.ex: The commercial ship sailed to another country.
words.ex_cn: 这艘贸易船只驶向了另一个国家。
words.en: Commercial relates to the business of buying and selling goods and services.

words.ex: The economic situation is getting worse.
words.ex_cn: 经济状况正在恶化。
words.en: Economic means concerned with the organization of the money, industry, and trade of a country, region, or society.

words.ex: The country's economy is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的经济正在快速增长。
words.en: The economy of a country or region is the system by which money, industry, and trade are organized.

words.ex: The children hang their coats on the hooks.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把他们的外套挂在挂钩上。
words.en: A coat is a piece of clothing with long sleeves which you wear over your other clothes when you go outside.

words.tr: phrase. 化装舞会所穿着的服装
words.ex: The children wore fancy dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们穿着奇装异服去参加派对。
words.en: Clothing worn to impersonate someone or something, often at a party or event.

words.ex: He bought new walking boots for the hike.
words.ex_cn: 他为远足买了新的1058型徒步靴。
words.en: Walking boots are sturdy footwear designed for walking long distances, typically used for hiking or trekking.

words.tr: n. 步行； v. 步行；行走；“walk”的现在分词； adj. 步行的；
words.ex: Walking is good for your health.
words.ex_cn: 步行对健康有益。
words.en: Walking is the activity of going for a walk, especially for pleasure or exercise.

words.ex: He wore heavy boots to walk in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了厚重的靴子在雪地里走路。
words.en: Boots are a type of footwear that covers the foot and extends up the leg, sometimes to the knee or even the hip. They are typically made of leather or rubber and are worn for protection against cold, wet, or rugged terrain.

words.ex: She wore a dress made of cotton.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件棉质裙子。
words.en: Cotton is a plant that produces a soft fiber which is used to make cloth or thread. Cotton is also the cloth or thread that is made from this fiber.

words.ex: She knits a sweater from wool.
words.ex_cn: 她用羊毛织毛衣。
words.en: Wool is the hair that grows on sheep and some other animals, which is used to make clothes, blankets, etc.

words.ex: She wears a silk dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件丝绸连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A fine, strong, soft, lustrous fiber produced by silkworms in making cocoons and collected to make thread and fabric.

words.ex: He bought new clothing for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 他为冬天买了新衣服。
words.en: Clothing refers to items worn on the body. Clothing is typically made of fabrics or textiles but over time has included garments made from animal skin or other thin sheets of materials put together.

words.ex: He hangs his clothes on the line to dry.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服挂在绳子上晾干。
words.en: Clothes are the things that people wear, such as shirts, coats, trousers, and dresses.

words.tr: n. 包装；装箱；包装物； v. “package”的现在分词；
words.ex: The packaging of the gift was very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 这份礼物的包装非常漂亮。
words.en: The materials in which goods are wrapped or packed, especially commercially.

words.ex: He put the books in a box.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放进了一个箱子里。
words.en: A box is a container with a flat base and sides, typically square or rectangular and having a lid.

words.ex: She gave her friends gifts on Christmas.
words.ex_cn: 她在圣诞节给了朋友们礼物。
words.en: A gift is something that you give someone as a present.

words.ex: The selection of books was very good.
words.ex_cn: 书籍的选择非常好。
words.en: The act of carefully choosing someone or something as the best or most suitable.

words.ex: He is choosing a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 他正在选择一部新手机。
words.en: The act of selecting or making a decision when faced with two or more possibilities.

words.ex: The bank gave a loan to the student.
words.ex_cn: 银行向学生提供了一笔贷款。
words.en: A loan is a sum of money that you borrow.

words.ex: He checked his bank statement last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚查看了他的银行对账单。
words.en: A bank statement is a document that shows all the transactions that have occurred in a bank account over a specific period of time, usually a month.

words.ex: I deposited money at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 我到银行存了钱。
words.en: A bank is an institution where people or businesses can keep their money or borrow money. It can also refer to the land alongside a river or lake.

words.ex: The bank did a credit check before giving the loan.
words.ex_cn: 银行在发放贷款前进行了信用检查。
words.en: A credit check is an examination of an individual's or company's credit history, typically conducted by a financial institution or lender to assess their creditworthiness.

words.ex: She stayed in a luxurious hotel with gold faucets.
words.ex_cn: 她住进了一家有金色水龙头的奢侈酒店。
words.en: Something that is luxurious is very comfortable and expensive, and often involves great pleasure or indulgence.

words.tr: adj. 更便宜的；“cheap”的比较级；
words.ex: This shirt is cheaper than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫比那件更便宜。
words.en: Comparative form of cheap: costing less money than something else or than is usual.

words.ex: This shirt is cheap and nice.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫又便宜又好看。
words.en: If something is cheap, it costs less money than usual or than you expected.

words.ex: I need the money for the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我需要这笔钱来付账单。
words.en: Money is the coins or bank notes that you use to buy things, or the amount of these that you have.

words.tr:
n. 费用；代价；
v. 花费；
words.ex: The cost of the book is ten dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的费用是十美元。
words.en: The amount of money that you need in order to buy, make, or do something.

words.tr: n. 标签；“label”的复数； v. 贴标签；
words.ex: The bottles have clear labels.
words.ex_cn: 这些瓶子上有清晰的标签。
words.en: A label is a piece of paper, plastic, or other material which is attached to an object and gives information about it.

words.ex: The prices of fruits went up last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周水果的价格上涨了。
words.en: The amount of money expected, required, or given in payment for something.

words.tr: phrase. 购物中心；大型购物商场（复数）
words.ex: They go to shopping malls on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他们周末去购物中心。
words.en: A shopping mall is a large building or series of connected buildings containing a variety of retail stores and often also restaurants and other businesses.

words.ex: The shoppers bought apples and bread at the market.
words.ex_cn: 顾客们在市场买了苹果和面包。
words.en: People who are shopping or intending to shop.

words.ex: He buys milk and bread at the grocery.
words.ex_cn: 他在杂货店买牛奶和面包。
words.en: A grocery is a store where food and small items for the house are sold.

words.ex: The company's sales increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 该公司上个月的销售额增加了。
words.en: The exchange of a commodity for money; the action of selling something.

words.ex: He works in retail at a small store.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小店从事零售工作。
words.en: The sale of goods to the public in relatively small quantities for use or consumption rather than for resale.

words.tr: n. 亲属；亲缘植物（或动物）；亲属( relative的名词复数 )；
words.ex: I visited my relatives during the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 我在假期探望了我的亲属。
words.en: Your relatives are the members of your family.

words.tr: n. （十三到十九岁的）青少年
words.ex: The teenager walks to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个青少年每天步行上学。
words.en: A teenager is someone who is between thirteen and nineteen years old.

words.ex: My grandparents, my parents, and I are three generations.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖父母、父母和我是三代人。
words.en: Generations refer to all of the people born and living at about the same time, regarded collectively. It can also refer to the average period, generally considered to be about thirty years, in which children grow up, become adults, and have children of their own.

words.tr: n. 同龄人；同辈；“peer”的复数；
words.ex: He talks more freely with his peers.
words.ex_cn: 他和同龄人在一起时更放松。
words.en: People who are the same age or have the same status as you.

words.ex: The young boy plays soccer every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个年轻的孩子每天下午都踢足球。
words.en: Someone who is young has not lived for very long or is not yet mature.

words.ex: The boys are playing soccer in the park.
words.ex_cn: 这些男孩正在公园里踢足球。
words.en: Boys are male children or young men.

words.ex: The children are playing in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在公园里玩耍。
words.en: Children are people who are not yet adults, typically those who are under the age of 18.

words.ex: The babies are sleeping in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿们正在婴儿床里睡觉。
words.en: Very young children, especially those who cannot yet walk or talk.

words.ex: There are 31 women in the meeting room.
words.ex_cn: 会议室里有31名女性。
words.en: Women are adult human females.

words.ex: The twins are playing in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 双胞胎正在花园里玩耍。
words.en: Twins are two offspring produced by the same pregnancy.

words.ex: The two dogs are similar in color.
words.ex_cn: 这两只狗的颜色很相似。
words.en: If one thing is similar to another, or if two things are similar, they have features that are the same.

words.ex: He bought three pairs of shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他买了三双鞋。
words.en: Two things of the same type that are used together or regarded as a unit.

words.ex: Her husband cooks dinner every night.
words.ex_cn: 她的丈夫每天晚上做晚饭。
words.en: A married man considered in relation to his spouse.

words.tr: n. 母亲；根源（mother 的复数）；
words.ex: Mothers love their children deeply.
words.ex_cn: 母亲们深爱着自己的孩子。
words.en: A mother is a female parent of a child. Mothers are women who inhabit or perform the role of bearing some relation to their children, who may or may not be their biological offspring.

words.ex: My parents go to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母每天早上去上班。
words.en: Your parents are your mother and father.

words.ex: Good relationships need trust and communication.
words.ex_cn: 良好的关系需要信任和沟通。
words.en: The way in which two or more people or things are connected.

words.tr: adj. 相关的；连接的； v. 连接；“connect”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The two events are connected.
words.ex_cn: 这两个事件是相关的。
words.en: If one thing is connected with another, there is a link or relationship between them.

words.ex: We bought a family ticket for the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 我们买了一张家庭票去动物园。
words.en: A family ticket is a type of admission ticket that allows a group of people, typically consisting of two adults and a certain number of children, to enter an event or venue at a reduced rate compared to purchasing individual tickets.

words.ex: My family members eat dinner together every night.
words.ex_cn: 我的家人每天晚上一起吃晚饭。
words.en: Family members are individuals related by blood, marriage, or adoption, who form a household together.

words.ex: This is my 588th family photo.
words.ex_cn: 这是我的第588张家庭合影。
words.en: A photograph of all the members of a family together.

words.tr:
n. 家庭；家族；
adj. 家庭的；家族的；
words.ex: He belongs to the 587 family.
words.ex_cn: 他属于587家族。
words.en: A family is a group of people who are related to each other, especially parents and their children.

words.ex: The homeless man slept on the bench.
words.ex_cn: 那个无家可归的人睡在长椅上。
words.en: If someone is homeless, they have no permanent place to live.

words.tr:
n. 家；家庭；
adv. 在家；
adj. 家的；家庭的；
words.ex: I love to go home after work.
words.ex_cn: 我下班后喜欢回家。
words.en: The place where one lives permanently, especially as a member of a family or household.

words.ex: Reading a book gives me relaxation.
words.ex_cn: 读书让我放松。
words.en: Relaxation is the state or process of becoming less tense, anxious, or stressed.

words.ex: He is stretching his arms before running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步前伸展手臂。
words.en: The act of making something longer or wider by pulling it.

words.tr: n. 重量；重物；重要性；负担；
words.ex: The weight of the box is 10 kilograms.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子的重量是10公斤。
words.en: Weight is the force with which a body is attracted toward the earth or a celestial body by gravitation and which is equal to the product of the mass and the local gravitational acceleration.

words.ex: China uses a lot of energy from coal.
words.ex_cn: 中国使用大量煤炭能源。
words.en: Energy is the ability and strength to do active physical things and the feeling that you are full of physical power and life.

words.ex: His strength helped him lift the heavy box.
words.ex_cn: 他的力量让他举起了那个重箱子。
words.en: The quality or state of being physically strong.

words.ex: He is an intermediate student in English.
words.ex_cn: 他是英语的中级学生。
words.en: An intermediate stage, level, or position is one that occurs between two other stages, levels, or positions.

words.ex: He took an intensive English course last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，他参加了一个密集的英语课程。
words.en: Intensive is used to describe something that involves a lot of effort, energy, or attention in a short period of time.

words.ex: He is strong enough to lift the box.
words.ex_cn: 他很强壮，足以举起这个箱子。
words.en: Someone who is strong is healthy with good muscles and can move or carry heavy things, or do hard physical work.

words.ex: The movements for clean water grew stronger last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年，清洁用水的活动变得更强烈了。
words.en: Movements refer to the act or process of moving or being moved; a change of position or place. It can also denote a group of people working together to advance their shared political, social, or artistic ideas.

words.tr:
n. 锻炼；行使；练习；
v. 运用；使用；锻炼；
words.ex: He does exercise every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上锻炼以保持健康。
words.en: Physical activity that you do to make your body strong and healthy.

words.ex: The children are playing on the playground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在游乐场上玩耍。
words.en: A playground is an area designed for children to play in, especially at a school or in a park.

words.tr: phrase. 入会费；加入时需缴纳的费用
words.ex: You must pay a joining fee to use the gym.
words.ex_cn: 你要支付一笔入会费才能使用健身房。
words.en: A joining fee is a sum of money that you pay when you become a member of a club or organization.

words.ex: He goes to the gym every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身房。
words.en: A gym is a place equipped for physical exercise and training, especially for athletes or for people who want to keep fit.

words.tr: n. 航海；帆船运动； v. 航行；“sail”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves sailing on the open sea.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱在公海上航海。
words.en: The activity or sport of moving across water in a boat that is propelled by the wind.

words.ex: He plays chess every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上下棋。
words.en: Chess is a board game for two players, each beginning with 16 pieces of six kinds that are moved according to specific rules, the object being to checkmate the opponent's king.

words.tr: n. 骑自行车； v. 骑自行车；“cycle”的现在分词；
words.ex: Cycling is good for health.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车对健康有益。
words.en: Cycling is the activity of riding a bicycle, especially as a sport or for pleasure.

words.ex: He plays golf every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都打高尔夫。
words.en: Golf is a game in which you use long sticks called clubs to hit a small hard ball into holes that are spread out over a large area of grassy land.

words.ex: He won three competitions last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年赢得了三场比赛。
words.en: Competitions are events in which people or teams compete against each other in order to win.

words.ex: He used a stopwatch to time the race.
words.ex_cn: 他用秒表计时比赛。
words.en: A stopwatch is a watch that can be started and stopped by pressing a button, used for timing events accurately.

words.tr: n. 赛车；竞赛； v. 比赛；疾走；“race”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves watching racing on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末观看赛车。
words.en: Racing is the sport of competing in races, especially horse races or car races.

words.tr:
n. 赛跑；竞争；种族；
v. 比赛；快速移动；
words.ex: He won the race by running fast.
words.ex_cn: 他通过快速奔跑赢得了赛跑。
words.en: A race is a competition to see who is the fastest, for example in running, swimming, or driving.

words.ex: He plays tennis every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打网球。
words.en: Tennis is a game played by two or four players on a rectangular court, in which a ball is hit back and forth over a net using rackets.

words.tr:
adv. 在户外；在野外；
n. 野外；旷野；郊外；
words.ex: The children love to play outdoors.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在户外玩耍。
words.en: If something happens outdoors, it happens outside in the fresh air rather than in a building.

words.tr: phrase. 国际健康；国际卫生
words.ex: Health international programs help children in poor countries.
words.ex_cn: 国际健康项目帮助贫困国家的儿童。
words.en: A term that may refer to an organization, publication, or initiative focused on global health issues, often used in contexts like 'Health International' as a proper name.

words.ex: She eats healthy food every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天吃健康的食物。
words.en: Someone who is healthy is well and is not suffering from any illness.

words.ex: Good food and sleep help maintain health.
words.ex_cn: 良好的饮食和睡眠有助于保持健康。
words.en: The condition of a person's body or mind, especially in terms of the presence or absence of illnesses, injuries, or impairments.

words.ex: His participation in the meeting was very important.
words.ex_cn: 他参与会议非常重要。
words.en: The act of taking part in something.

words.ex: He loves playing sports after school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢放学后参加体育运动。
words.en: Sports are physical activities or games, often competitive and organized, that involve skill and physical exertion.

words.tr: phrase. 俱乐部房间；社团活动室
words.ex: The students gather in the club room after school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们放学后聚集在社团活动室。
words.en: A room in a club used for social gatherings, meetings, or other activities.

words.ex: He joins a chess club after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后加入了一个国际象棋俱乐部。
words.en: A club is an organization of people with a common purpose or interest, who meet regularly and take part in shared activities. It can also refer to a heavy stick used as a weapon or for hitting a ball in sports.

words.ex: Watching movies is a popular entertainment.
words.ex_cn: 看电影是一种流行的休闲娱乐。
words.en: Entertainment refers to performances or activities that are intended to amuse or interest an audience.

words.ex: The audience clapped loudly after the show.
words.ex_cn: 演出结束后，观众热烈鼓掌。
words.en: The group of spectators at a public event; listeners or viewers collectively, especially those attending a performance or reading a particular work.

words.ex: His performance in the game was excellent.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的表现非常出色。
words.en: The act of performing a play, concert, or some other form of entertainment.

words.ex: The actors performed a funny play last night.
words.ex_cn: 男演员们昨晚表演了一出滑稽的戏剧。
words.en: An actor is a person whose profession is acting on the stage, in films, or on television.

words.ex: Many people go to cinemas on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 很多人在周末去电影院。
words.en: A cinema is a place where people go to watch films.

words.tr: phrase. 故事研讨会；剧本讨论会
words.ex: They attended a story conference last week.
words.ex_cn: 他们上周参加了一个故事会议。
words.en: A meeting where writers, directors, and producers discuss and develop the plot and structure of a story.

words.ex: The child listens to stories every night before bed.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子每晚睡觉前听故事。
words.en: Stories are accounts of imaginary or real people and events told for entertainment.

words.tr: v. 拍成电影；“film”的现在分词； n. 拍摄；
words.ex: They started filming the movie last week.
words.ex_cn: 他们上周开始拍这部电影。
words.en: The process of making a film or movie.

words.tr:
n. 电影；底片；薄薄的一层；
v. 拍摄电影；
words.ex: I watched a funny film last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚看了一部有趣的电影。
words.en: A film is a series of moving pictures, usually shown in a cinema or on television and often telling a story.

words.ex: He plays the piano every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上弹钢琴。
words.en: A piano is a large musical instrument with a keyboard. When you press the keys, small hammers hit strings inside the piano, which produce musical notes.

words.tr:
n. 竖琴
v. 反复诉说；唠叨
words.ex: She plays the harp beautifully at concerts.
words.ex_cn: 她在音乐会上优美地演奏竖琴。
words.en: A harp is a large musical instrument consisting of a triangular frame with vertical strings which you pluck with your fingers. If someone harps on about something, they keep talking about it in a way that other people find annoying.

words.ex: The lab has many scientific instruments.
words.ex_cn: 实验室有许多科学仪器。
words.en: An instrument is a tool or device used for a particular task, especially for scientific, medical, or technical work.

words.tr: adj. 流行的；受欢迎的；大众的；
words.ex: This song is popular among teenagers.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在青少年中很流行。
words.en: liked, admired, or enjoyed by many people or by a particular person or group

words.ex: She loves to listen to old songs.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢听老歌。
words.en: A song is a short piece of music with words that are sung.

words.ex: They practice music in the concert room.
words.ex_cn: 他们在音乐厅里练习音乐。
words.en: A room designed for the performance of concerts, typically equipped with seating for an audience and designed with good acoustics.

words.ex: He loves listening to music every night.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每天晚上听音乐。
words.en: Music is the pattern of sounds produced by people singing or playing instruments.

words.ex: The painters created beautiful murals on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 画家们在墙上创作了美丽的壁画。
words.en: Individuals who create paintings as their profession.

words.tr:
n. 油漆；绘画颜料；
v. 刷油漆；画；
words.ex: The paint on the wall is peeling.
words.ex_cn: 墙上的油漆正在剥落。
words.en: Paint is a coloured liquid that you put onto a surface with a brush in order to protect the surface or to make it look nice, or to produce a picture.

words.tr:
v. 集中；聚焦；
n. 中心点；焦点；
words.ex: He needs to focus on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

words.ex: He showed me his photographs from the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他给我看了他旅行时拍的照片。
words.en: A photograph is a picture made using a camera, in which an image is focused onto film or other light-sensitive material and then made visible and permanent by chemical treatment, or stored digitally.

words.ex: I put the photos on the table.
words.ex_cn: 我把照片放在桌子上。
words.en: Photos are images taken by a camera and recorded on a photosensitive surface or digitally.

words.ex: He showed me his images from the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他给我看了他旅行时拍的照片。
words.en: Pictures or photographs, especially those created electronically.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们周日参观了一家艺术画廊。
words.en: A gallery is a place where works of art are shown to the public.

words.tr:
n. 舞蹈；
v. 跳舞；
words.ex: She loves to watch the traditional dance.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢观看传统舞蹈。
words.en: To move your body rhythmically to music, typically following a set sequence of steps.

words.ex: He has a talent for playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他有弹钢琴的才能。
words.en: If someone has a talent for something, they have a natural ability to do it well.

words.ex: He is a creative boy who draws nice pictures.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有创造力的男孩，会画漂亮的画。
words.en: Someone who is creative has the ability to invent and develop original ideas, especially in the arts.

words.tr: phrase. 艺术节；艺术庆典活动
words.ex: The city hosts an annual arts festival in the summer.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市每年夏天都会举办艺术节。
words.en: An arts festival is a festival that features various art forms such as music, dance, theater, and visual arts, often held annually and attracting participants and audiences from a wide area.

words.ex: He majored in arts at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修人文学科。
words.en: The arts are activities such as music, painting, literature, film, and dance, which people can take part in for enjoyment, or to create works which express important meanings or ideas.

words.ex: The company publishes an annual report every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每年发布一份年度报告。
words.en: A document prepared by a company at the end of each year, giving details of its financial performance and activities over the year.

words.tr: n. 报告；报道；“report”的复数； v. 报告；报道；
words.ex: The students handed in their science reports yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 学生们昨天交上了他们的科学报告。
words.en: Reports are detailed accounts or statements about a particular subject, especially one that is investigated or analyzed. They can also refer to the act of reporting or the process of gathering and presenting information.

words.tr:
n. 研究；探索；调查；
v. 研究；调查；探讨；
words.ex: He did research on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了关于气候变化的研究。
words.en: Research is work that involves studying something and trying to discover facts about it.

words.tr: n. 调查；勘测；“survey”的复数； v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did surveys about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: Surveys are a method of gathering information from a sample of people, traditionally with the intention of generalizing the results to a larger population.

words.ex: I am guessing the answer is 5.
words.ex_cn: 我正在猜答案是5。
words.en: the act of estimating or supposing without sufficient information

words.ex: He did an analysis of the data.
words.ex_cn: 他对数据进行了分析。
words.en: Analysis is the process of considering something carefully or using statistical methods in order to understand it or explain it.

words.ex: The boy picked up the objects on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩捡起了地上的物品。
words.en: Objects are physical things that you can see and touch. In grammar, an object is a noun, pronoun, or noun phrase that receives the action of a verb or is affected by it.

words.ex: The students meet in a discussion group every week.
words.ex_cn: 学生们每周都参加一个讨论小组。
words.en: A discussion group is a group of people who meet to discuss a particular topic or issue.

words.ex: The students are divided into small groups.
words.ex_cn: 学生们被分成几个小组。
words.en: A group of people or things is a number of people or things which are together in one place at one time.

words.tr: n. 结果；成绩；比分；计算的结果；“result”的复数； v. 起因；导致；
words.ex: The results of the test were good.
words.ex_cn: 这次测试的结果很好。
words.en: Results are the outcomes or consequences of actions, events, or processes.

words.tr: n. 试验；检测；考试；测验； v. 试验；测试；“test”的现在分词；
words.ex: The testing of the new car took three months.
words.ex_cn: 新车的试验花了三个月。
words.en: The process of subjecting something to a test to determine its qualities or performance.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.ex: He wrote three short essays about his travels.
words.ex_cn: 他写了三篇关于他旅行的短随笔。
words.en: A short piece of writing on a particular subject, often expressing personal views.

words.ex: I remember my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我记得我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you remember people or events from the past, you still have an idea of them in your mind and you are able to think about them.

words.ex: She writes in her diaries every night.
words.ex_cn: 她每天晚上都写日记。
words.en: A diary is a book which has a separate space for each day of the year. You use a diary to write down things you plan to do, or to record what happens in your life day by day.

words.tr: phrase. 详细的笔记；详尽的记录
words.ex: He took detailed notes during the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 他在讲座期间做了详细的笔记。
words.en: Comprehensive and thorough written records of information, often including observations, data, and analysis, for study or reference.

words.tr: phrase. 笔记系统；注释体系
words.ex: He uses a note system to remember his tasks.
words.ex_cn: 他使用一个笔记系统来记住他的任务。
words.en: A method or set of rules for recording information, often in written form.

words.tr:
n. 笔记；便条；音调；注释；语气；
v. 注意；记录；
words.ex: I took notes during the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我在讲座期间做了笔记。
words.en: A note is a short piece of writing, a musical sound, or a piece of paper money. It can also mean to pay attention to something or to write something down.

words.ex: He spilled ink on his shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他把墨水洒在了衬衫上。
words.en: Ink is the colored liquid used for writing, printing, or drawing.

words.ex: He bought three new pens for school.
words.ex_cn: 他为学校买了三支新笔。
words.en: A pen is an instrument for writing or drawing with ink, typically consisting of a metal nib or ball, or a nylon tip, fitted into a metal or plastic holder.

words.ex: He types fast on the keyboard.
words.ex_cn: 他打字很快，用的是键盘。
words.en: A keyboard is a panel of keys that operate a computer or typewriter.

words.tr: n. 拼写；拼法； v. “spell”的现在分词；
words.ex: His spelling is very poor.
words.ex_cn: 他的拼写很差。
words.en: The forming of words from letters according to accepted usage; orthography.

words.tr: v. “write”的过去分词；写作；书写； adj. 书面的；
words.ex: The letter was written by hand.
words.ex_cn: 这封信是手写的。
words.en: Something that is written has been recorded in writing rather than spoken.

words.tr: n. 写作；文章； v. 写作；“write”的现在分词；
words.ex: His writing is clear and simple.
words.ex_cn: 他的写作清晰简洁。
words.en: The activity or skill of marking coherent words on paper and composing text.

words.tr: n. 倾听；收听； v. 听；“listen”的现在分词；
words.ex: Good listening helps you understand others.
words.ex_cn: 良好的倾听能帮助你理解他人。
words.en: The act of paying attention to and trying to hear something.

words.tr: n. 阅读；读物； v. 读；“read”的现在分词；
words.ex: Reading is an important skill for students.
words.ex_cn: 阅读是学生的重要技能。
words.en: The action or skill of reading written or printed matter silently or aloud.

words.ex: Teachers attend professional learning workshops every month.
words.ex_cn: 教师们每月参加专业学习研讨会。
words.en: Professional learning refers to the process of acquiring new knowledge, skills, and competencies related to one's profession or career. It is aimed at improving professional practice and enhancing the quality of service or product delivery.

words.tr: n. 学习；学问； v. 学习；“learn”的现在分词；
words.ex: Learning takes time and practice.
words.ex_cn: 学习需要时间和练习。
words.en: The acquisition of knowledge or skills through study, experience, or being taught.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet is compulsory for cyclists.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔是必须的。
words.en: If something is compulsory, you must do it because of a rule or law.

words.tr: n. 知识；了解；学问；学识；
words.ex: He gained knowledge from reading books.
words.ex_cn: 他通过读书获得了知识。
words.en: Knowledge is information and understanding about a subject which a person has, or which all people have.

words.ex: Scientists study the stars and planets.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究恒星和行星。
words.en: A scientist is someone who has studied science and whose job is to teach or do research in science.

words.ex: He wants to study life science in university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习生命科学。
words.en: Life science is a branch of science that deals with the study of living organisms and their vital processes.

words.ex: He loves science and reads books about it.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢科学，经常读关于它的书。
words.en: Science is the study of the nature and behaviour of natural things and the knowledge that we obtain about them.

words.ex: He works at a small law firm.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小型律师事务所工作。
words.en: A law firm is a business entity formed by one or more lawyers to engage in the practice of law. The primary service rendered by a law firm is to advise clients (individuals or corporations) about their legal rights and responsibilities, and to represent clients in civil or criminal cases, business transactions, and other matters in which legal advice and other assistance are sought.

words.ex: He broke the law and was arrested.
words.ex_cn: 他违反了法律，被逮捕了。
words.en: A law is a rule or set of rules for good behaviour which is considered right and important by the majority of people for moral, religious, or emotional reasons.

words.ex: Ancient philosophers asked big questions about life.
words.ex_cn: 古代哲学家思考关于生命的重大问题。
words.en: A philosopher is someone who studies or writes about philosophy, which is the study of fundamental questions about existence, knowledge, values, reason, mind, and language.

words.ex: He likes to study philosophy in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间学习哲学。
words.en: Philosophy is the study or creation of theories about basic things such as the nature of existence, knowledge, and thought, or about how people should live.

words.ex: He is interested in politics.
words.ex_cn: 他对政治感兴趣。
words.en: Politics are the actions or activities concerned with achieving and using power in a country or society. The verb that follows politics may be either singular or plural.

words.ex: He loves mathematics because it is logical.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学，因为它有逻辑性。
words.en: Mathematics is the study of numbers, shapes, and patterns using reason and usually a special system of symbols and rules for organizing them.

words.ex: He likes math because it is easy.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学，因为它很简单。
words.en: Math is the study of numbers, quantities, and shapes.

words.ex: He loves reading classical history books.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读古典历史书籍。
words.en: Classical history refers to the history of the ancient Greeks and Romans, which is considered foundational to Western civilization.

words.tr: phrase. 经济史；对历史上经济制度、活动与发展变化的研究
words.ex: He is learning economic history at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习经济史。
words.en: Economic history is a field of study that examines the development of economies over time, including the factors that have influenced their growth and decline.

words.ex: He likes to read history books about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读关于古罗马的历史书籍。
words.en: History is the study of past events, particularly in human affairs.

words.tr: phrase. 传统文学；指世代相传、具有文化根基的文学作品
words.ex: He reads traditional literature from his country.
words.ex_cn: 他阅读自己国家的传统文学。
words.en: Traditional literature refers to the body of written works that are considered to have artistic or intellectual value, and are passed down through generations, reflecting the culture and values of a society.

words.tr: phrase. 现代语言（尤指在欧洲作为外语教授的当代欧洲语言，如法语、德语、西班牙语等）
words.ex: He learns modern languages at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习现代语言。
words.en: Modern languages refer to languages that are currently in widespread use across the globe, as opposed to classical languages which are no longer spoken in their original form.

words.ex: He speaks English as his first language.
words.ex_cn: 他说英语作为他的第一语言。
words.en: Language is the system of communication in speech and writing that is used by people of a particular country or area.

words.tr: n. 显微镜( microscope的名词复数 )
words.ex: The students look at cells through microscopes.
words.ex_cn: 学生们通过显微镜观察细胞。
words.en: An optical instrument used for viewing very small objects, such as mineral samples or animal or plant cells, typically magnified several hundred times.

words.ex: The students work in laboratories to test science experiments.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在实验室里做科学实验。
words.en: A laboratory is a place equipped for scientific experiments, research, or teaching, or for the manufacture of drugs or chemicals.

words.ex: There was a big improvement in his English skills.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语水平有了很大改进。
words.en: The act of making something better or the state of being made better; an example or instance of this.

words.ex: The body has a mechanism to fight viruses.
words.ex_cn: 人体有一种对抗病毒的机制。
words.en: A mechanism is a part of a machine that does a particular task, or a system that is intended to achieve something or deal with a problem.

words.ex: He uses simple methods to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用简单的方法解决数学问题。
words.en: A method is a particular way of doing something.

words.ex: Follow the guidelines to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 遵循指南以通过考试。
words.en: Guidelines are general rules, principles, or pieces of advice that help you to do something or to decide what to do in a particular situation.

words.tr: n. 导游；指南；“guide”的复数； v. 指导；指引；
words.ex: The guides showed us the ancient ruins.
words.ex_cn: 导游带我们参观了古代遗址。
words.en: If you guide someone, you show them the way to a place or you help them to do something by explaining or showing them how to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 高级顾问；资深督导师
words.ex: He is a senior advisor at the company.
words.ex_cn: 他是这家公司的高级顾问。
words.en: A senior advisor is a person who provides expert advice to an organization or individual, often in a specific field or area of expertise.

words.ex: He watches online tutorials to learn coding.
words.ex_cn: 他观看在线教程来学习编程。
words.en: A tutorial is a period of teaching given by a tutor to an individual or a small group of students.

words.tr: n. 导师；家庭教师；“tutor”的复数；
words.ex: The students meet their tutors every week.
words.ex_cn: 学生们每周都见他们的导师。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one student or a very small group of students. As a verb, to tutor means to teach someone privately.

words.ex: The teachers help students learn math.
words.ex_cn: 教师帮助学生学习数学。
words.en: A teacher is a person who teaches, especially in a school.

words.ex: He gave two reasons for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了两个迟到的原因。
words.en: A cause, explanation, or justification for an action or event.

words.ex: He made a mistake in his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you make a mistake, you do something which you did not intend to do, or which produces a result that you do not want.

words.ex: The answer is incorrect.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案是不正确的。
words.en: If something is incorrect, it is not accurate or true.

words.ex: He left the unanswered questions on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把那些未回答的问题留在了桌上。
words.en: If a question or problem is unanswered, it has not been answered or solved.

words.ex: I check the website every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天检查这个网站。
words.en: To visit a specific webpage, typically to find information, check availability, or confirm details about services or events.

words.tr: phrase. 内部网站；仅限内部人员访问的网站
words.ex: The company uses an internal website for employee messages.
words.ex_cn: 公司使用内部网站来发送员工信息。
words.en: An internal website is a website that is accessible only to the members of a particular organization, used for sharing information, resources, and tools among employees.

words.ex: He visits the website every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天访问这个网站。
words.en: A website is a set of related web pages located under a single domain name, typically produced by a single person or organization.

words.ex: He uses the internet to find information.
words.ex_cn: 他使用因特网来查找信息。
words.en: The internet is a global system of interconnected computer networks that use the Internet protocol suite (TCP/IP) to link devices worldwide.

words.tr: phrase. 来自互联网的信息；网络资讯
words.ex: He found useful information from internet for his project.
words.ex_cn: 他从互联网上找到了对他项目有用的信息。
words.en: Data or knowledge obtained from websites and online resources.

words.tr: phrase. 信息行业；信息产业
words.ex: The information sector grows fast in this country.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的信息产业增长很快。
words.en: The part of the economy that involves the production, processing, and distribution of information.

words.ex: The teacher gave us important information about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们关于考试的重要信息。
words.en: Information is facts or details about a subject, event, or situation.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；
words.ex: The river's source is in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的源头在山里。
words.en: The place, person, or thing from which something comes or can be obtained.

words.tr: n. 工具；刀具；器具；“tool”的复数；
words.ex: He uses simple tools to fix the chair.
words.ex_cn: 他用简单的工具修理椅子。
words.en: Tools are objects such as hammers, screwdrivers, or saws that you use to help you do a particular type of work.

words.tr:
v. 支持；支撑；
n. 拥护；帮助；
words.ex: My friends support me when I feel sad.
words.ex_cn: 当我感到难过时，我的朋友们支持我。
words.en: If you support someone or their ideas or aims, you agree with them, and perhaps help them because you want them to succeed.

words.ex: He walks to class on campus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行到校园上课。
words.en: The grounds and buildings of a university or college.

words.ex: He works at a small college.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所小型学院工作。
words.en: A college is an institution where students study after they have left school, in order to get a degree or qualification.

words.ex: He taught math in primary school.
words.ex_cn: 他在小学教数学。
words.en: A primary school is a school for children between the ages of about five and eleven.

words.ex: The schools are open every weekday.
words.ex_cn: 这些学校每个工作日都开放。
words.en: A school is an institution designed for the teaching of students under the direction of teachers.

words.ex: He goes to university to study engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他上大学学习工程。
words.en: A university is an institution where students study for degrees and where academic research is done.
